svg.text: Handoff Guardian | Process, AI and automation
One end-to-end view • human decisions, automated work and one managed AI agent • Google Cloud prototype
Upload PDF, TXT or Markdown sources.
Decide what counts as accepted scope.
Use the project's recorded business time.
Document AI OCR reads every PDF.
Store canonical text + originals in GCS.
Cloud Tasks invokes the private worker.
Worker calls the managed AI agent.
Recheck schema, IDs and exact quotes.
ADK runs the bounded analysis workflow.
03 Handoff Guardian agent | ADK on Vertex AI Agent Engine
One read-only workflow calling Gemini 3.8 Flash on Vertex AI; the three capabilities below belong to this same agent.
New or reviewed evidence → run a fresh assessment
Cloud Tasks delivers jobs; Firestore stores the outbox.
Cloud Scheduler checks unfinished work every minute.
Leases, fencing and idempotency control duplicates.
New or reviewed evidence increments the revision.
Re-run analysis and create a fresh proposal as needed.
An old approval cannot authorize a changed payload.
A task records the next step
A blocker task does not establish delivery or acceptance.
Finding disposition and commitment closure are explicit reviews.
Accepted scope always comes from reviewer decisions.
Blue: human decisions • Amber: automated work / OCR • Purple: one AI agent and its capabilities • Green: persisted outcome • Dashed arrows: feedback / ready-state return
